<P STYLE="font: 11pt/107% Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company is withdrawing its Report on Form 8-K that it filed on July 14, 2016 as Form Type 8-K12G3 (the &ldquo;July 14
8-K&rdquo;). Pursuant to Rule l2g-3(a) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, the Company will promptly file
a new Report on Form 8-K, that will be identical to the original July l4 8-K, as Form Type 8-Kl2B. </FONT></P>
